name: gce-instance-selector
description: Selects and ranks Google Compute Engine (GCE) instance types and storage configurations based on hardware requirements (vCPU, memory, CPU/GPU/TPU, architecture, NIC egress bandwidth, Hyperdisk/PD performance, local SSD) and pricing tiers (on-demand, Spot, CUD, DWS). Use when users ask for GCE machine type recommendations, hardware sizing, price comparisons, or boot/data disk compatibility. Don't use for executing bulk VM deployments, MIG creation, or Cloud Batch job submissions (use gce-flexibility skill instead).
